component.name: OpenMoji Color
component.summary: Open source emojis for designers, developers and everyone else!

description.p: A project of students and professors of the HfG Schwäbisch Gmünd.
OpenMoji uses visual guidelines that are not linked to a specific branding. The emojis are designed to integrate well in combination with text.
